description: The AppForShare Android store listings of this workspace: status (DRAFT = setup not finished, READY = waiting for the first store build, LISTED, SUSPENDED) and what is still missing, the package name claim (verified, pending, failed with the reason, or disputed; a dispute is settled automatically from the evidence, proof of the signing key beating a repository token file), the source repository, tag and build variant, the releases with their status (QUEUED = waiting for the author's GitHub Actions build, PENDING = waiting for our own builder for GitLab and plain git sources, PENDING_REVIEW = APK received, automatic review checks running, IN_REVIEW = a clean update on its short hold before it is approved by itself, APPROVED = reviewed and ready for signing, SIGNING, SIGNED = signed APK stored with its SHA-256, size and certificate, PUBLISHED = live in the AppForShare store, SIGN_FAILED with the reason (retried by itself, then Try signing again in the Store tab), REJECTED with the reason and the fix; every release is reviewed automatically by our checks and an AI review, and staff can review any decision later; each release carries its review: decidedBy AUTO or STAFF, the reasons it needed a decision, the findings in plain words, the time of the automatic approval, the rejection reason, the fix, and whether the author can ask once for a re-review or use Recheck in the Store tab), the signing of the listing (mode STORE_KEY = AppForShare signs with a key made for this app, AUTHOR_SIGNS = the author signs each release with the CLI appforshare store sign, OWN_KEY = AppForShare signs with the imported keystore of the author, Team; the certificate SHA-256 users will see, fixed by the first signed release; never key material), the targets of each release (afs = the AppForShare store, play = Google Play, appstore = the App Store, each with its own status: WAITING, QUEUED, SENDING, PROCESSING, LIVE, DRAFT = a Play production draft, FAILED with the reason, WITHDRAWN; sends to Google Play and the App Store are made by an Admin in the Store tab or with the CLI appforshare store send, never from here), the GitHub Actions store builds (PENDING_REVIEW = accepted, REJECTED with the reason in plain words, SHA-256, versionCode, run link) with the workflow block to add to the repository, and the public page address. Without project or app, every store app in short. Setting up, claiming and starting releases happen in the Store tab of the project, never from here. No secrets (the webhook secret is never shown). Read only. Every plan with an account.
